title: 16 Nobel Laureates Just Warned: AI Will Hit Harder Than Industry
description:
Sixteen Nobel laureates just raised the alarm at the same time and apparantly this has never happened before in history. 😳

Over 200 top economists and AI reserchers signed a statement called "We Must Act Now", and the message is pretty blunt: they think AI will hit the economy harder than the Industrial Revolution did. The scary part is timing. Steam, electricity and computers gave society decades to adjust, AI is giving us like a couple of years 🔥

Their whole point comes down to one thing. Either AI lifts the standard of living for everyone or it just funnels all the wealth to a tiny handful of people, and what decides it is what we actualy do right now, not after its already happened. ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
